```{r}
library(tableone)
vars_cont <- c("age","bwt", "id","bp_sys")
vars_cat  <- c("birth", "smoke", "preterm", "neocare")

table1 <- CreateTableOne(
  vars       = c(vars_cont, vars_cat),
  data       = data_o,
  factorVars = vars_cat
)

# print Table 1
print(table1, showAllLevels = TRUE, quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE)
summary(table1)
```


```{r}
# 1. 加载必要的包 / Load libraries
library(dagitty)
library(ggdag)
library(ggplot2)

# 2. 定义 DAG 结构并手动设置坐标 (pos)，以确保清晰度
# Define DAG and manual coordinates for a clean flow (from left to right)
coords <- list(
  x = c(age = 0, smoke = 1, high_bp = 1, birth = 2, preterm = 2, low = 3, neocare = 4),
  y = c(age = 1, smoke = 2, high_bp = 0, birth = 1.2, preterm = 0.5, low = 1, neocare = 1)
)



#   age -> birth
#   birth -> low
#   birth -> preterm
#   age -> smoke
#   smoke -> low
#   smoke -> preterm
#   age -> low
#   age -> high_bp
#   age -> preterm
#   high_bp -> low
#   preterm -> low
#   low -> neocare
#   high_bp -> preterm
#   preterm -> neocare
dag_model <- dagitty("
dag {
  age -> {smoke birth high_bp low}
  smoke -> {low preterm}
  birth -> low
  high_bp -> {low preterm}
  preterm -> low
}

")

# 将坐标应用到 DAG / Assign coordinates
coordinates(dag_model) <- coords

# 3. 整理数据并绘图 / Tidy and Plot
tidy_dag <- tidy_dagitty(dag_model)

ggplot(tidy_dag, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  # 绘制箭头和线条 / Edges with curvature or straight lines
  geom_dag_edges(edge_color = "grey50", arrow_directed = grid::arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed")) +
  # 绘制节点 / Nodes
  geom_dag_node(color = "steelblue", size = 14) +
  # 添加变量文本 / Node labels
  geom_dag_text(color = "white", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  # 优化视觉效果 / Aesthetic improvements
  theme_dag() +
  labs(title = "Causal Relationship DAG: Pregnancy and Birth Outcomes",
       subtitle = "From Pre-pregnancy Status to Neonatal Care") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))
```

```{r}
# full model construction
total <- glm(low ~ smoke + age, family = binomial, data = data_a)
total_c <- glm(low ~ smoke + age + smoke*age, family = binomial, data = data_a)
summary(total)
summary(total_c)

# direct <- glm(low ~ smoke + age + preterm, family = binomial, data = data_a)
# summary(direct)
```

```{r}
# use package for standardization
library(stdReg)
std_fit <- stdGlm(fit = total_c, data = data_a, X="smoke")
summary(std_fit)
summary(object = std_fit, transform = "logit", contrast = "difference", reference = 0)
```
```{r}
# standardization manually
## marginal risks
data0 <- data_a
data0$"smoke" <- 0
pred0 <- predict(object = total_c, newdata = data0, type = "response")
p0 <- mean(pred0)
p0
data1 <- data_a
data1$"smoke" <- 1
pred1 <- predict(object = total_c, newdata = data1, type = "response")
p1 <- mean(pred1)
p1

# marginal causal effects
## log or
logit_p1 <- qlogis(p1)
logit_p0 <- qlogis(p0)
log_or_m <- logit_p1-logit_p0
## risk difference 
rd <- p1-p0
## risk ratio
rr <- p1/p0

# display results
cat("The marginal casual log odds ratio is", log_or_m,"\n")
cat("The casual risk difference is", rd,"\n")
cat("The causal risk ratio is", rr)
```
